_comment: Inputs for the npm part of the generated notices at /licenses/ (scripts/sbom/notices.ts). The package list itself is not typed here: it is every package whose modules the production build puts in its chunks, plus `servedCopies` (packages whose files the build copies into the site as they are). Each package's own licence files are copied from node_modules. `upstreamTexts` covers packages that ship no licence file but whose upstream project has one (files in ./texts/). `elections` records which licence PQC Today uses for a package offered under a choice. Anything else without a licence file gets the standard text of its declared licence with the author from its package.json.

servedCopies.pyodide: public/pyodide/ (Python runtime for the Developer tabs)

pyodide.note: Pyodide's files are under MPL-2.0, and stay under it; their source is https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.28.3. The runtime contains CPython 3.13.2 (PSF licence). Other libraries compiled into the Pyodide runtime are listed in Pyodide's own repository and are not reproduced here yet.

otherServedFiles.name: flag-icons v7.5.0 (public/flags/, all flags except g7, nato and int, which are drawn for this project)
